title: Economizer Commanded Open With Damper Mechanically Stuck
description: Provides favorable economizer weather and a 100 percent command, then pins the effective outside-air damper near minimum ventilation so the command, air-mixing process, and fault evidence disagree.

events.description: Jam the physical OA damper near minimum position

expected_results: The 100 percent command remains visible while mixed air stays much warmer than favorable outside air
The process evidence is consistent with a damper/linkage problem, not an unfavorable-weather lockout
After the fault clears, mixed air moves toward outside air with actuator and plenum lag
completion_criteria: Student distinguishes a command problem, an actuator problem, and an enthalpy lockout
Student supports the diagnosis with outside-, return-, and mixed-air trends
instructor_notes: The feedback alias is an internal physical fault hook and is intentionally not another BACnet object. Students should diagnose from command and process consequences before the fault is revealed.
student_objectives: Diagnose an economizer actuator failure without relying on a hidden fault label
